'''Fornax''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Glythe sector/Legends|Glythe sector]], well known throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] as being home to the [[Fire Rings of Fornax]].

==History==
From a distance, the planet seemed to be surrounded by five rings of fire. The rings were actually large solar prominences that encircled the planet, attracted to it by its close proximity to the [[Star system/Legends|system's]] [[Star/Legends|star]]. The Fire Rings were one of the natural wonders of the galaxy and not only attracted tourists wanting to view their beauty, but also daredevil young [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] who risked their lives to fly through the Rings. One such pilot was a young [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]].

The sideorder dish [[Fiery Fornax rings|Fornax rings]] was shared its name with planet's rings.<ref name="DAD">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref>
